s1.quote: Atago Maru rests upright in 14 metres (46 ft) of water, about one mile (1.6 km) offshore. … The wreck is a popular dive site.

s2.quote: The Atago Maru Wreck, a World War II Japanese ship, lies in a depth of about 14 metres, covered with corals. … normally around 20 – 40 metres.

summary.text: WWII Japanese ship sitting upright in about 14 m roughly 1.6 km off Miri, Sarawak, where it was bombed at anchor in 1944. Coral-encrusted and a popular local wreck dive; visibility can be challenging.
